events.title: Challenger Colorado Second Saturday Science — The Season of Lights: Build & Launch Rockets and Northern Lights Take-Home STEM
events.time: Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM MST; planetarium timed ticket options 9:15, 9:45, 10:15, 10:45, 11:15 AM
events.location: Challenger Learning Center of Colorado, 8717 Wolf Valley Drive, Colorado Springs, CO 80924
events.cost: FREE admission and planetarium tickets; $0 for five family members. Transport and parking costs not confirmed.
events.age: School-age students with parents/guardians; family/general public welcome; precise minimum age not stated.
events.description: Official Dec 12 2026 special collaborative hands-on event with Colorado Springs Utilities and Space Foundation Discovery Center: assemble and potentially launch a 3D-printed rocket, construct a portable Northern Lights display to take home, and experience an aurora planetarium presentation. Separate date/topic and take-home build from Nov 14 Mars event previously submitted. RSVP required to guarantee planetarium places/materials; ticketing page currently lists free spots. Register by Fri Dec 11 2026, 4 PM MST; walk-ins possible without guarantee. Rocket launch subject to fire restrictions/weather. For 2026 Colorado-based friends; before planned family stay.
